name: Fishbone
description: Embroidered leaves in fishbone stitch, each half worked in slanting satin stitches that meet at the midrib, scattered at angles that sway together across the sheet.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { --k: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-transform: rotate(@calc(@rn(-80, 80, 1.6) + @r(-25, 25))deg) scale(1.1); transform: rotate(@calc(@rn(-80, 80, 1.6) + @r(-25, 25))deg) scale(1.1); :before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: -25%; background: @p(@var(--k)); -webkit-clip-path: @var(--right); clip-path: @var(--right); -webkit-mask: @var(--stitch); mask: @var(--stitch); -webkit-transform: rotate(-45deg); transform: rotate(-45deg); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: -25%; background: @p(@var(--k)); opacity: 0.72; -webkit-clip-path: @var(--left); clip-path: @var(--left); -webkit-mask: @var(--stitch); mask: @var(--stitch); -webkit-transform: rotate(45deg); transform: rotate(45deg); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
